_comment: Projects the core (JoeysRetroHandhelds/joey64-core) is built from, or that we follow for ideas. devtools/check-upstreams.py lists commits newer than 'seen' (optionally only those touching 'path'). 'seen' = the newest commit we have merged or read. After merging or reading new commits, set 'seen' to the newest one and close that source's issue.

sources.name: parallel-RDP in libretro parallel-n64
sources.why: libretro's reworked parallel-RDP, much newer than the author's public copy; port its speed changes (emulator-review.md). Up to 03b056b read 2026-11-15: from 11-12 libretro rewrites parallel-RDP in C (not ours to take); four bugs it fixed on the way are in our C++ copy too and ported (core 431aec4: 79cf993, 5c3fd3b, a08bedc, b1213d1); the lock-free pool fixes (f80b843, 499816b) are for code we do not have; 288f3a0 already holds in ours; 804ba99 not a bug here
